name: Gadnic PROJ100W
summary: Gadnic PROJ100W ships with telemetry, ads and unused stick apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: The Gadnic PROJ100W projector from Argentina has a built-in 4K Google TV stick. It ships with telemetry and remote management, ads and personalization, factory test apps, extras that do not belong on a projector stick, and a voice assistant. The list has 20 apps.

On this unit the setup wizard holds the saved Wi-Fi, and turning it off too early drops the projector's Home. Forgetting and rejoining the network first fixes that. TidyTV turns the rest off from your phone with a backup first and deletes nothing. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The setup wizard, until your Wi-Fi is rejoined
Google Play Store and Play Services
notes: Turning off the setup wizard gives the home screen back but breaks casting with Chromecast built-in.
If the setup wizard holds your Wi-Fi, forget and rejoin the network in Settings before turning it off.

faq.q: Will casting still work on my Gadnic projector?
faq.a: Yes, unless you turn off the setup wizard. That one gives back the home screen but breaks Chromecast built-in casting.
Not if you forget and rejoin the network in Settings first. Turning off the setup wizard early deletes a network saved during first setup.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns the apps back on and puts the stock home screen back in one tap.
